title: A furniture showroom in Milan
assumptions: A furniture brand's showroom selling wood and upholstered furniture, formed as an Italian SRL, with staff and a sign. The SCIA covers a sales area up to 250 m² (an esercizio di vicinato); a larger showroom needs an authorisation instead.

items.name: Business register entry through ComUnica
items.agency: Registro delle imprese, Camera di commercio
items.quote: Tutte le imprese di qualsiasi natura giuridica si debbono iscrivere al Registro delle imprese.
items.quoteEn: Every business, whatever its legal form, must enter the business register.

items.name: VAT number (partita IVA)
items.quote: Agenzia delle Entrate (per i fini fiscali)

items.name: Employer registration with INPS and INAIL
items.quote: Istituto Nazionale della Previdenza Sociale (per i fini previdenziali)
items.quoteEn: National Social Security Institute (for social security purposes)

items.name: Shop opening notice (SCIA), for a shop of up to 250 m² of sales area
items.agency: Comune di Milano, SUAP (Sportello Unico Attività Produttive)
items.quote: Per aprire o modificare un esercizio di vicinato occorre presentare, esclusivamente per via telematica al SUAP (Sportello Unico Attività Produttive) del Comune di Milano
items.quoteEn: To open or change a neighbourhood shop you must file, online only, with the City of Milan's SUAP
items.condition: Only when it applies to this opening (see the assumptions).

items.name: Deforestation Regulation: due diligence for wood furniture
items.agency: European Commission, EUDR Information System (checked by the national competent authority)
items.quote: Large and medium operators: 30 December 2026 Micro and small operators: 30 June 2027

items.name: General Product Safety Regulation: a responsible operator in the EU
items.agency: European Union (Regulation (EU) 2023/988), enforced by the national market surveillance authority
items.quote: A product covered by this Regulation shall not be placed on the market unless there is an economic operator

items.name: Shop sign notice (SCIA)
items.agency: Comune di Milano, Area Pubblicità e Occupazione Suolo
items.quote: SEGNALAZIONE CERTIFICATA INIZIO ATTIVITA’ finalizzata alla installazione di insegne di esercizio e/o targhe professionali
items.quoteEn: Certified notice of start of activity for putting up business signs or professional plates
items.condition: Only when it applies to this opening (see the assumptions).

mustNotInclude.name: Rome's or the national SCIA row
mustNotInclude.why: Milan's own SUAP entry replaces it.
